definitions.gloss: upper rank, higher position, top tier
definitions.explanation: A higher position within a ranking, hierarchy, or classification. Used in competitive contexts such as sports, academics, business, and search results.

examples.japanese: {検索|けんさく}{結果|けっか}の{上位|じょうい}に{表示|ひょうじ}される。
examples.english: Appear at the top of search results.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{大会|たいかい}では、{上位|じょうい}{三名|さんめい}に{賞金|しょうきん}が{贈|おく}られる。
examples.english: At this year's tournament, prize money will be awarded to the top three.

notes:
{上位|じょうい} refers to the higher end of a ranking or hierarchy. Its counterpart is {下位|かい} (lower rank).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上位|じょうい}に{入|はい}る (place in the top ranks)
- {上位|じょうい}に{食|く}い{込|こ}む (break into the top ranks)
- {上位|じょうい}ランキング (top ranking)
- {上位|じょうい}{互換|ごかん} (upward compatibility)
- {売|う}り{上|あ}げ{上位|じょうい} (top sellers)
- {上位|じょうい}{概念|がいねん} (superordinate concept)

USAGE:
- Often used as a prefix modifier: {上位|じょうい}モデル (higher-end model), {上位|じょうい}{機種|きしゅ} (higher-end model/device)
- Common in business, technology, and sports contexts
